CREDIT AGREEMENT dated as of January 20, 2025, among Westmark Logistics Holdings LLC, as Borrower, the Lenders party hereto and Pinnacle Commercial Bank, as Administrative Agent.

ARTICLE I DEFINITIONS

SECTION 1.01 Defined Terms . As used in this Agreement, the following terms have the meanings specified below:

"Default" means any event that is, or with notice or lapse of time or both would be, an Event of Default.

"Indebtedness" means, as to any Person, all obligations of such Person for borrowed money.

"Loan Documents" means this Agreement, the Notes and the Security Documents.

"Permitted Acquisition" means any acquisition of all or substantially all of the assets of a Person that is consented to by the Required Lenders.

"Subsidiary" means any corporation or other entity that is controlled by the Borrower.

ARTICLE VII NEGATIVE COVENANTS

SECTION 7.01 Indebtedness . The Borrower shall not create, incur or assume any Indebtedness, except:

(a) Indebtedness under the Loan Documents;

(b) other Indebtedness in an aggregate principal amount not to exceed $25,000,000 at any time outstanding;

(c) Indebtedness owed to the Borrower by any Subsidiary;

(d) Indebtedness in respect of capital leases in an aggregate principal amount not to exceed $5,000,000 at any time outstanding; and

(e) Indebtedness assumed in connection with a Permitted Acquisition in an aggregate principal amount not to exceed $15,000,000 at any time outstanding.

SECTION 7.02 Liens . The Borrower shall not create any Lien on any property, except Liens securing Indebtedness permitted under Section 7.01(d).
